svg.text: Stable core executable + hot-swappable gameplay modules, built on a shared Common DLL, a static Library and vendored dependencies.
window, rendering, input, scenes, networking — never recompiled for mods
host-side wrappers that load each DLL and call its exported entry points
AI · Asset · Item · Economy · FogOfWar · Interface · Projectile · Resource · Triggers · ShellModule · UIModule · Host
loads the DLLs listed in Resources/modules.json at runtime (LoadLibrary / dlopen)
gameplay as plug-and-play mods — one shared library per folder
Lexer → Parser → Interpreter · FileSystem · Editor · Highlight
each module carries its own *States.h state machine
Entry points exported with MODULE_API (extern "C") from common/module_interface.h.
Modules never call each other — the Game scene holds every handle and brokers between them (e.g. UI console window ↔ Shell).
the executable and every module link Common + Library
Orders · ItemOrder · Navigation · PassableGrid · GridTracker · Cells
Window · ImageLoader · Physics · Logs · Debug · FrameTrace · Utils
pulled in with add_subdirectory, linked by everything above
data the engine reads at runtime
